overview: The Community Development Board endorsed an Approval Not Required (ANR) lot reconfiguration plan, continued a public hearing on a proposed inclusionary zoning amendment for fractional payments, and reviewed administrative timelines and process improvements for future zoning projects.

items.title: ANR Plan Endorsement: 145 Jerome Street and 166 Arlington Street
items.summary: The Board approved and endorsed an Approval Not Required (ANR) plan to reconfigure two existing residential lots to facilitate future two-family housing developments.

items.title: Public Hearing: Inclusionary Zoning Fractional Payments Amendment
items.summary: The Board discussed a proposed amendment to allow fractional payments to the affordable housing trust for developments requiring less than a half-unit fraction, and voted to continue the public hearing to the August 12th meeting.

items.title: Zoning Project Timeline and Administrative Updates
items.summary: Staff provided updates on upcoming zoning studies, and Board members expressed a strong preference for dedicated working sessions over joint City Council meetings to prevent process rushing and member burnout.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: The Board approved the meeting minutes from June 23, 2026, and June 24, 2026.
